FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = #{TAX0302}) difbetIncome, (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = #{ALT0102}) constructionTax, (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = #{ALT0202}) educationTax, (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM
